predecessors.name: Twenty-seventh Dynasty of Egypt
predecessors.text: Egypt, from which Amyrtaeus expelled the Persians (Memphis in 405)

successors.name: Twenty-ninth Dynasty of Egypt
successors.text: Egypt, taken by Nefaarud I of Mendes in 398

ledger.x: 404: Amyrtaeus proclaims himself Pharaoh of Egypt after Darius II's death, having expelled the Persians from Memphis in 405 BC.
398: Nefaarud I of Mendes overthrows Amyrtaeus.
398: the Twenty-eighth Dynasty ends with the deposition and execution of Amyrtaeus; the page says it "lasted from 404 BC to 398 BC".

wars.name: Nefaarud I's rising against Amyrtaeus
wars.outcome: Nefaarud I defeated Amyrtaeus in open battle and put him to death at Memphis; the page gives no campaign years.
